arxiv-1907-06048.title: Multi-Element Long Distance Dependencies: Using SP k Languages to Explore the Characteristics of Long-Distance Dependencies
arxiv-1907-06048.creator: Abhijit Mahalunkar, John D. Kelleher
arxiv-1907-06048.description: Abstract In order to successfully model Long Distance Dependencies (LDDs) it is necessary to understand the full-range of the characteristics of the LDDs exhibited in a target dataset. In this paper, we use Strictly k -Piecewise languages to generate datasets with various properties.

arxiv-2111-07191.title: drpop: Efficient and Doubly Robust Population Size Estimation in R
arxiv-2111-07191.creator: Manjari Das, Edward H. Kennedy
arxiv-2111-07191.description: Abstract This paper introduces the R package drpop to flexibly estimate total population size from incomplete lists. Total population estimation, also called capture-recapture, is an important problem in many biological and social sciences. A typical dataset consists of incomplete lists of individuals from the population of interest along with some covariate information.

arxiv-2409-14540.title: Geometric Optimization of Quantum Control with Minimum Cost
arxiv-2409-14540.creator: Chengming Tan, Yuhao Cai, Jinyi Zhang, Shengli Ma, Chenwei Lv, Ren Zhang
arxiv-2409-14540.description: Abstract We investigate the optimization of quantum control from a differential geometric perspective. In our approach, optimal control minimizes the cost associated with evolving a quantum state, with the cost quantified by the length of the trajectory on a relevant Riemannian manifold.

arxiv-2509-18497.title: Differentiable Light Transport with Gaussian Surfels via Adapted Radiosity for Efficient Relighting and Geometry Reconstruction DOI: 10.1145/3763305 Journal: TOG CCS: Computing methodologies Rendering
arxiv-2509-18497.creator: Kaiwen Jiang, Jia-Mu Sun, Zilu Li, Dan Wang, Tzu-Mao Li, Ravi Ramamoorthi
arxiv-2509-18497.description: Abstract . Radiance fields have gained tremendous success with applications ranging from novel view synthesis to geometry reconstruction, especially with the advent of Gaussian splatting. However, they sacrifice modeling of material reflective properties and lighting conditions, leading to significant geometric ambiguities and the inability to easily perform relighting.

arxiv-2510-17094.title: Gertsenshtein effect on the spacetime curved by background magnetic field with geometric optics
arxiv-2510-17094.creator: Ryutaro Tomomatsu, Teruaki Suyama, Paolo Gondolo
arxiv-2510-17094.description: Abstract When electromagnetic (or gravitational) waves propagate in the presence of a background magnetic field, a portion of the waves converts into gravitational (or electromagnetic) waves. This phenomenon, known as the (inverse) Gertsenshtein effect, is typically analyzed in Minkowski spacetime, neglecting the spacetime curvature induced by the magnetic field itself.

arxiv-2601-03780.title: Assessing and Improving the Representativeness of Code Generation Benchmarks Using Knowledge Units (KUs) of Programming Languages – An Empirical Study
arxiv-2601-03780.creator: Md Ahasanuzzaman, Bram Adams, Emad Fallahzadeh, Gustavo A. Oliva, Ahmed E. Hassan
arxiv-2601-03780.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, Calude, LLaMA and StarCoder have achieved notable progress in code generation tasks, with benchmark datasets like HumanEval and MBPP serving as the primary means of evaluating their code-generation performance. Effective code generation requires models to understand and correctly apply the underlying programming language concepts (e.g., concurrency).

arxiv-2602-04849.title: El Agente Estructural: An Artificially Intelligent Molecular Editor
arxiv-2602-04849.creator: Changhyeok Choi, Yunheng Zou, Marcel Müller, Han Hao, Yeonghun Kang, Juan B. Pérez-Sánchez, Ignacio Gustin, Hanyong Xu, Mohammad Ghazi Vakili, Chris Crebolder, Alán Aspuru-Guzik, Varinia Bernales
arxiv-2602-04849.description: Abstract We present El Agente Estructural, a multimodal, natural-language–driven geometry-generation and manipulation agent for autonomous chemistry and molecular modelling. Unlike molecular generation or editing via generative models, Estructural mimics how human experts directly manipulate molecular systems in three dimensions by integrating a comprehensive set of domain-informed tools and vision-language models.

pmc-10611081.title: Micronuclei, Pesticides, and Element Mixtures in Mining Contexts: The Hormetic Effect of Selenium
pmc-10611081.creator: Marcela E. Varona-Uribe, Sonia M. Díaz, Ruth-Marien Palma, Leonardo Briceño-Ayala, Carlos Trillos-Peña, Eliana M. Téllez-Avila, Lyda Espitia-Pérez, Karina Pastor-Sierra, Pedro Juan Espitia-Pérez, Alvaro J. Idrovo
pmc-10611081.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The contexts where there are mining and agriculture activities are potential sources of risk to human health due to contamination by chemical mixtures. These contexts are frequent in several Colombian regions. This study explored the potential association between the frequency of micronuclei and pesticides and elements in regions with ferronickel (Montelibano, Córdoba) and gold (Nechí, Antioquia) mining, and a closed native mercury mine (Aranzazu, Caldas), with an emphasis in the potential effect of selenium as a potential chelator.

pmc-11620039.title: Upconversion enhancement and temperature sensing studies in Li+ ions incorporated GdPO4:Tm3+/Yb3+ phosphor
pmc-11620039.creator: Madan M Upadhyay, Kaushal Kumar
pmc-11620039.description: The GdPO4:Tm3+/Yb3+ phosphor codoped with various concentrations of Li + ions were synthesized for upconversion emission and optical thermometry studies. Excitation using 980 nm laser diode results in three upconversion (UC) emission bands with centre wavelengths of 478, 648 and 692 nm. These bands are originated from 1G4→3H6, 1G4→3F4, and 3F3→3H6 transitions of the Tm3+ ion, respectively.

pmc-11712640.title: Implementation of the meaningful activity for managing behavioral symptoms of distress (MAC‐4‐BSD) intervention in assisted living
pmc-11712640.creator: Susan Scherr
pmc-11712640.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMost assisted living (AL) settings organize and provide opportunities for residents to participate in activities (e.g., exercise, music, arts and craft, cognitive activities, religious services, community outings). Despite the known benefits of activity participation, it is widely reported that there is a lack of activities that are considered meaningful for residents and thus many residents spend much of their time during the day disengaged.

pmc-12519213.title: Combined pesticide pollution enhances the dissemination of the phage-encoded antibiotic resistome in the soil under nitrogen deposition
pmc-12519213.creator: Luo-Qin Shen, Da Lin, Yu-Qiu Ye, Yanjie Liu, Bang Ni, Di Wu, Lu Wang, Dong Zhu
pmc-12519213.description: SignificancePhage-mediated dissemination of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) is a key driver of environmental antibiotic resistance and is increasingly influenced by global change and human activities. However, the mechanisms through which soil phages facilitate ARG spread under multiple stresses remain poorly understood. This study shows that nitrogen deposition intensifies pesticide-induced soil stress, promoting the activation and transfer of phage-encoded ARGs.

pmc-12729072.title: The latent tuberculosis infection survey using two interferon γ release assay tests among the elderly in a well-confined rural county in Eastern China
pmc-12729072.creator: Xineng Jiang, Yaling Feng, Zhicheng Yu, Bin Chen, Wei Wang, Guoyong Jiang, Lanqin Hu, Wenzhou Tong, Qian Chen, Mingwu Zhang, Yelei Zhu, Kui liu, Jianmin Jiang
pmc-12729072.description: BackgroundTuberculosis (TB) latent infection is a crucial precursor to the development of active pulmonary tuberculosis while currently no gold standard for detecting latent infection. This study aims to investigate the prevalence of latent infection among the elderly in high-incidence areas in Eastern China.

pmc-13337791.title: A linear models approach to optimize carbazole-based dyes for solar cell applications
pmc-13337791.creator: Emanuel F dos S Mattos, Carlos R A Daniel, Nivan B da Costa Júnior
pmc-13337791.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The excellent characteristics of carbazole-based dyes have resulted in DSSCs with power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) that are among the highest for metal-free dyes. However, the rational modification of these structures remains a challenge. In this work, 126 carbazole-based dyes were used in the development of models to predict the efficiency of DSSCs and to describe the relation between dye structure and cell efficiency.

pmc-13402109.title: Longitudinal associations and mechanisms linking frailty, depression, and self-perceptions of aging among community-dwelling older adults: a psychosomatic interaction perspective
pmc-13402109.creator: Yongwei Liu, Yuyang Luo, Junjun Sun, Huimin Zhang, Yanyan Luo, Guodong Wang, Guiying Yao
pmc-13402109.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the longitudinal dynamic relationships among frailty, depression, and self-perceptions of aging in community-dwelling older adults, to analyze the mediating role of depression between frailty and aging cognition, and to provide a theoretical basis for physical and mental health interventions for this population.

pmc-13466068.title: Teleconsultation and proxy visits, and tele-diabetes education: The need of the hour for managing gestational diabetes mellitus
pmc-13466068.creator: Felix K. Jebasingh, Nihal Thomas
pmc-13466068.description: wever, our article highlights the importance of telemedicine in managing hyperglycemia in pregnancy in the current scenario, which could complement regular hospital visits. Hyperglycemia in pregnancy has been on the rise over the last three to four decades due to a broader change in lifestyle patterns and a parallel increase in the prevalence of obesity.
